intended_object: The set P of LM24 (Section 6.2): the principal RV classes of nonpositive Hahn series K((ℝ^{≤0})) under the degree valuation, viewed inside the degree-graded associated graded ring through the canonical embedding of RV classes as homogeneous initial forms. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The definition says x lies in the image of `IsPrincipalRV` under the canonical RV-to-graded map `(degreeValuation K).rvInitialFormHom`. In other words, there is an RV class B such that B is the RV class of a principal series p and the initial form of B is x. This is exactly the image of the paper's set of principal RV classes inside the graded ring, as the docstring and the module documentation describe.

The theorem `isPrincipalRVImage_iff` in the same file supports this reading. It shows the predicate holds exactly for the nonzero homogeneous graded elements whose single component is principal. That matches the paper's description of P.

The setting is the paper's own: K a field of characteristic zero, Hahn series with exponents in ℝ, and the degree valuation. The notion only makes sense in that setting, so the definition is not too narrow. Mathlib has no counterpart, since it has no principal series, degree valuation or RV graded ring for Hahn series.
